page_title: MNU 3-1 AST | Manchester Utd v Aston Villa 15/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
90+6' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+2' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), but Emiliano Martinez is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
90+1' Here is a change. Casemiro is going off and Michael Carrick gives the last tactical orders to Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United).
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Aston Villa.
89' A quickly taken corner by Aston Villa.
89' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is about to take a corner kick.
86' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Andres Garcia.
85' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
82' Unai Emery has decided to substitute Ross Barkley and he is replaced by Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa).
82' Lucas Digne goes off the pitch and Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) comes on.
81' 3 - 1 Goal! Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Emiliano Martinez. He makes it 3:1.
79' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
76' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is penalised for holding. Anthony Taylor signals a set piece.
75' The manager makes a subsitution with Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) coming on for Bryan Mbeumo.
72' What was Leny Yoro (Manchester United) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
71' 2 - 1 Goal! Bruno Fernandes tees up Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 2:1.
71' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
69' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
68' Good clearance! Tammy Abraham (Aston Villa) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
67' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Aston Villa players have a reason to celebrate!
66' Wait! Referee Anthony Taylor has indicated he is going to review the Aston Villa goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
64' 1 - 1 Goal! Ross Barkley (Aston Villa) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
64' The ball is out of play and Aston Villa manage to earn a corner.
64' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot into the roof of the net as the goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop.
63' A cross into the box finds the head of Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) who steers it goalwards, but Emiliano Martinez manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
61' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) replacing John McGinn.
60' Substitution. Ollie Watkins makes his way off the pitch and Tammy Abraham (Aston Villa) comes on as his replacement.
60' Tyrone Mings (Aston Villa) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar.
60' John McGinn (Aston Villa) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
60' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Casemiro (Manchester United) for his blatant foul.
59' Casemiro (Manchester United) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Anthony Taylor saw the whole situation.
58' Now Aston Villa have a corner.
57' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.
56' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
56' Casemiro (Manchester United) brings his opponent down. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Aston Villa have a free kick from a promising distance.
54' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.

53' 1 - 0 Bruno Fernandes takes over corner duties and expertly finds Casemiro (Manchester United), who scores with a header that bounces up off the ground and goes into the bottom left corner. The score is now 1:0.
52' The referee awards a corner and Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) goes over to take it.

52' The ball is laid off to Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Emiliano Martinez to make a decent save.
51' Wasted effort! Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
51' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
51' A cross from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) and Casemiro combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
48' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
47' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' John McGinn (Aston Villa) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' John McGinn (Aston Villa) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. Aston Villa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45' Leny Yoro (Manchester United) commits a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
44' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
43' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
41' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is booked by the referee.
41' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
40' John McGinn (Aston Villa) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
38' A lofted pass finds Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar.
37' Casemiro (Manchester United) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
36' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
35' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
35' Manchester Utd take a short corner kick.
35' The linesman makes the right call and Manchester Utd will have a corner. Casemiro (Manchester United) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

30' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
29' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
28' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
25' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
24' A wild effort from John McGinn (Aston Villa) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
24' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa).
23' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the left post, but Emiliano Martinez is alert and denies him.
22' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
22' Casemiro (Manchester United) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd win a corner kick.
21' The resulting set piece from Manchester Utd is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
21' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
20' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
18' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

17' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The referee blows his whistle, Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
17' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
16' Casemiro (Manchester United) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
14' The Manchester Utd players are exchanging some short passes.
13' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
10' Casemiro (Manchester United) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for an infringement. Aston Villa get a free kick.
9' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
8' Casemiro (Manchester United) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
6' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
5' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Anthony Taylor no option but to blow his whistle.
4' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
2' Foul! Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Aston Villa will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Anthony Taylor.
